dispute.claim_text: Four hundred metres away and he never came. Thirty minutes. Then after I'd already gone home in another car, he 'arrived' and cancelled me for not being there. Of course I wasn't there! And the booking is still hanging in my app the next day. Can this driver even still take jobs?

counterparty_statement.text: I was stuck behind an accident. When I got there she was gone. I waited and cancelled. Standard.
